name: Ciabatta
summary: Slack, wet, wildly open. Poured rather than shaped.

steps.text: Mix to a batter-like dough. It should not hold shape.
Four sets of folds in the bowl, 30 minutes apart.
Tip onto a heavily floured bench and cut into rectangles.
Proof on a couche, transfer upside down to the oven.

bake.notes: Handle as little as humanly possible. Every touch closes the crumb.

notes: Flour the bench far more heavily than seems reasonable.
